senses.gloss:
ग्लै {c1c} P. (ग्लायति, ग्लान)
1 To feel
aversion or dislike, be unwilling or
disinclined to do anything (with
inf.).
--2 To be fatigued or wearied,
feel tired or exhausted.
--3 To
despond, sink in spirit, be dejected;
Bk. 19. 17, 6. 12.
--4 To wane,
fade, faint away. --Caus.
(ग्ल-ग्लापयति, but प्रग्लापयति)
1 To cause to
fade away, wither up; Ś. 3. 18;
Ku. 3. 49.
--2 To tire out, exhaust.
--3
To injure, trouble, hurt.
--4 To
emaciate, waste; Ku. 5. 29; U. 3. 5.
